summary: Shell completion for Ansible CLI tools comes from the optional argcomplete package, which supports bash fully and zsh/tcsh partly.
questions: How do I get tab completion for Ansible commands?
Does Ansible tab completion work in zsh?

answer_card.title: Tab completion for Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: Install the optional `argcomplete` package. It fully supports bash and has limited support for zsh and tcsh.
